setup.search: per (gate, mode): starts = designs of neighbouring gates (shrink crossover until the gate passes), 300 log-normal perturbations (sigma 0.3) of each, 2 best distinct starts that pass the time-domain screen refined by coordinate + random two-parameter pattern search on a decimated grid (1332 of 5601 points), then 2 fine steps on the full grid (every accepted design passes the time-domain screen: 80 mA clamp, no divergence, 0.2 s tail <= 50 urad or decaying (td_screen_sweep), round trip and load step); then the numeric DF of the whole cascade must meet the gate (S limit tightened by 0.05 per failure, up to 4 times). Gates are nested (G0 > G1 > ... > G5), so a backward pass G4..G1 restarts each gate from the stricter gates' optima

G5.label: repo gate: 96 models x delay 1/4/8 + worst period +6 (plus G4)

X_cb.label: G0 + C and viscous x0.5/1.5 (Jm,Jl,K nominal), delay 2 only

setup.crossover: first |L|=1 crossing of the nominal measured loop (G8 + 1 sample, DF controller)
